instruction: Remove the "ctrl+k ctrl+c" keyboard shortcut for adding line comments in VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the chord keyboard shortcut (ctrl+k ctrl+c) for adding line comments. The evaluator verifies keybindings.json contains the disabled command entry.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly fetches the VS Code keybindings.json file from the VM using get_vm_file
Metric check_json_keybindings properly reads the file and parses JSON (vscode.py:19-44)
Expected value is semantically correct: VS Code disables keybindings by prefixing command with '-' (e.g., '-editor.action.addCommentLine')
Comparison logic is correct: checks if the disable entry dict exists in the keybindings array
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the only requirement (keybinding is disabled)
Static warning about 'not reading vm_file' is a false positive - the metric does open and read the file at line 29

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_keybindings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_keybindings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
